question: Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma is associated with which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniyattam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma is renowned for her contribution to **Mohiniyattam**, a classical dance form from Kerala.
 
• She is often referred to as the **Mother of Mohiniyattam** for her pivotal role in reviving and popularizing the dance form.
 
• She was honored with the prestigious **Padma Shri** award in 1977 for her dedication to Indian classical dance.
 
• Her efforts in training and choreographing have significantly enriched the repertoire and status of Mohiniyattam on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohiniyattam**

 
 
• Mohiniyattam is a classical dance form that originates from the state of Kerala in South India.
 
• The name Mohiniyattam comes from "Mohini," a mythical enchantress avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu, and "attam," meaning dance.
 
• The dance is characterized by graceful, swaying body movements and subtle facial expressions, which are meant to enchant the audience.
 
• Mohiniyattam traditionally involves solo female performances, but it has evolved to include group performances as well.
 
 
 
• **Classical Dance Forms of India**
 
 
• India is home to eight recognized classical dance forms: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Sattriya, Manipuri, and Mohiniyattam.
 
• Each dance form is unique in its style, costumes, makeup, and music, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of different regions.
 
• These dance forms are deeply rooted in Indian mythology, spirituality, and folk traditions.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**
 
 
• Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India, awarded to individuals for their distinguished contributions in various fields.
 
• They are classified into three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri, in the order of their significance.
 
• The awards are announced annually on Republic Day (26th January).
